module_summary: Loadable up/down counter register stepping by a variable delta each enabled cycle, with an extra MSB (or sticky flag) reporting overflow.

anchors.name: counter_q
anchors.why: Counter register with overflow MSB; updated by load or +/- delta.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Enables counting by delta_i each cycle.

anchors.name: load_i
anchors.why: Loads d_i into the counter, overriding counting.

anchors.name: delta_i
anchors.why: Step amount added to or subtracted from counter_q.

anchors.name: d_i
anchors.why: Load value written into counter on load_i.

anchors.name: q_o
anchors.why: Count value output, lower Width bits of counter_q.

anchors.name: overflow_o
anchors.why: Overflow indication from counter MSB or sticky overflow flag.

groups.name: delta_counter
groups.description: Up/down delta counter with load and enable control.
